messages:
ben-cs: Alert  several onboarding imports failing with 429s and a few webhook retries dropping. Started ~04:20 UTC. Affected tenants include multiple trials and a couple renewal-risk customers. Need a clear customer note + prioritized remediation.
ivy-cs: Any hint from infra? Is this a quota enforcement or a spike?
martin-eng: Seeing token_budget exhaustion on the import route; concurrent synchronous imports + cache churn. We can enable soft per-account throttles and move heavy jobs to background queue. Patch ETA ~25m.
lucy-ops: Ill start requeueing large imports to the low-concurrency worker and tag verified failures for provisional credits.
ben-cs: Draft status for customers (short):
---
Hi — were aware of errors impacting bulk onboarding/imports (some jobs returning "rate limit"). Engineers are deploying a fix now; we expect normal behavior within ~30 minutes. Were reducing import concurrency and offering prioritized hands-on help to complete failed imports.
If you were impacted and want a live migration session, reply and well schedule a support call. We will follow up with an RCA and an account goodwill package.
— Redwood Inference CS
---
ivy-cs: Good start. For high-ARR customers, offer a dedicated migration clinic (1:1 session) + 2 free onboarding hours. Also include a direct support link and calendar.
ben-cs: Agree. Can renewals team help with outreach to top 4 at-risk accounts?
renewals-bot: Noted — pinging renewals leads for prioritized outreach.
martin-eng: Patch is at ~40% rollout; route error rate down ~68% in early telemetry. Still watching embedding fallback spikes.
lucy-ops: Provisional credit plan: 20% credit or two free onboarding hours for any verified failed imports; billing will finalize amounts after impact verification.
ben-cs: Action items:
- ivy-cs: finalize customer message with calendar link & support contact and send in next 15m.
- lucy-ops: tag impacted tenants in the incident sheet and provision provisional credits.
- martin-eng: confirm full rollout and post clearance message when stable.
- renewals-bot: coordinate direct outreach for top ARR accounts and attach migration clinic slots.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-29123 opened and assigned to eng-oncall (martin-eng).
ben-cs: I'll assemble an exec blurb once we have clearance and a first batch of customer replies. Keep replies and any customer logs in the incident doc: http://redwood.internal/incidents/29123.
ivy-cs: I'll post outreach snippets and canned responses here for CS to copy into Intercom/email.
ben-cs: Thanks team — reduce noise, prioritize high-touch, and gather logs for the RCA. :pray:
